description: This file declares the WebAudioClientBackend class, which implements the WebAudioClientBackendInterface for managing web audio playback, including creation, control, and querying of audio buffers and device info.

classes.name: WebAudioClientBackend
classes.description: Final class implementing WebAudioClientBackendInterface for managing web audio playback functionalities.

methods.name: createWebAudioBackend
methods.description: Creates the web audio backend with specified client, MIME type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioBackend
methods.description: Destroys the web audio backend, releasing resources.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of the web audio.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Signals end of stream for the web audio.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available buffer frames.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.
